note: Walk-forward backtest over 365 days: each day the experts and the direction model were refit on earlier data only, then the full online system (trust weights, conformal ranges, calibration) was stepped minute by minute. The direction model's settings were picked on Bitcoin (the sister project Bitcast) and used unchanged, so no Cardano day was used to choose them. Every forecast is in data/backtest/. The live record is what counts.
